scope: Native browser V2; finite-scene measurements, not scientific accuracy or permanent equilibrium
performanceMethod: Five alternating A/B rounds, four fixture-v1 scenes, same seed, 120 warmup ticks and 600 timed ticks each. Nearest-rank percentiles per trial, then median across five trials. Timing excludes setup, rendering, transport and hashing. Population evolution differs between engines.
profileTimingNote: Population profiles ran alongside other checks; their step timings are omitted from this report and are not used for performance claims.
